title: Retro Getaway - 4 miles to DT
description:
Enjoy a fun and retro experience at this centrally-located getaway condo. Feel a need for a vacation to Nashville, but don't​ want the hassle and high-prices of downtown? Stay with us! This studio, one bathroom condo is a private getaway suitable for up to five guests. Perfect for a small girls trip. Property is located within miles of the area's top attractions: the downtown honky-tonks of Broadway, Ryman Auditorium, The Grand Ole Opry, Opryland Hotel, and all the eating  you've heard about.

The space
The Sleeping Space--
Bedroom #1: 1 king
Living Room: sleeper sofa (twin)
Extra Beds: 1 twin roll away and 1 twin foam fold out

Bathroom #1: walk-in shower

About the home:
-1 bedroom (studio)
-1 bathroom
-5 people accommodation max

Local Attractions: 
-4 miles to downtown Nashville
-4 miles to Nashville International Airport
-5.5 miles 5 Points
-11 miles 51st Ave (Nations)
-13 miles to Cheekwood
-29 miles to Arrington Vineyards

House Amenities:
-WiFi
-Smart TVs
-Basic Amenities (paper products, soaps, trash bags, etc)
-Linens Provided
-Stocked Kitchen (cookware, utensils/knives, strainer)
-Keurig & coffee selection
-Extra mirrors to all get ready at the same time

OTHER THINGS TO NOTE: 
-- No parties, excessive noise, or illegal activity of any kind.
-- Check-in is any time after 3 p.m. Check-out by 10 a.m.
-- Parking is provided for ONE (1) vehicle.
-- Primary renter must be over the age of 21.
-- Maximum occupancy is never to exceed 5 people.
-- ID and signed rental agreement will be required after booking.  

Local Permit # - Issued Year 2023 followed by 009 then 640- this is required to legally rent in Nashville.

Guest access
Guests will receive a unique code to access the space that is valid from their check-in time to their check-out time.
